# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **GLES interop update**

## Highlights

The next 4.155 release modernizes GLES interop signatures and updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — Updates the GLES interop surface to use pointer-based signatures where native APIs require them. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine to the current HarfBuzz 14.4.0 release. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))
